name: split-squat-with-banded-adduction
instructions:
1. Attach a band to a rack, loop one end around your knee, and allow it to pull you into a valgus position (not excessively, just slightly).
2. Push out against the band to engage the glute and keep yourself in a more neutral position.
3. Set up in a split stance position with your hands by your side looking straight ahead.
4. Descend by flexing both knees simultaneously and continue until the back knee touches the ground directly beneath the hip.
5. Drive through the front foot and extend the knee as you return to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
